zh-Hans:
本轮重点：双语离线“帮助与指南”、搜索与设置直达；文件专属助手及引导/排队输入；音乐录制计时与对齐、保留已有片段及轨道伴奏；会议连续录音、分段转写、说话人标签、改名与合并；文件与回收站删除恢复、编辑操作及保存；任务完成与中断恢复、等待及倒计时控制；扩展工具箱、逐跳网络路径和可下载的离线 IP 资料库；Mac Bridge 错误提示、iPhone 窄屏/展开布局，以及更紧凑的绘画选项和“思维导图”入口。
请检查录制与伴奏、会议标签整理、帮助阅读、返回原任务、保存重开，并重点反馈 Linux 图形应用的启动、交互和停止。
本次中间内测不含新增的 Linux 视频硬件解码，原有视频编辑与播放功能保留。云端服务需自行配置，录音需麦克风权限。Siri 与快捷指令沿用已有功能。
en-US:
Focus on bilingual offline Help and Guides, search and setting links; file-specific assistants with steering/queued input; Music recording timing, alignment, preserved clips and track accompaniment; continuous meeting recording, segmented transcription, speaker labels, renaming and merging; file/Trash recovery, editing and saving; task completion, interrupted-task recovery, waits and countdown controls; expanded Toolbox tools, progressive Traceroute and a downloadable offline IP database; clearer Mac Bridge errors; compact/expanded iPhone layouts; and more compact drawing options with consistent Mind Map naming.
Please check recording and accompaniment, meeting labels, help articles, returning to the original task, and saving/reopening. Focus Linux graphical-app feedback on startup, interaction and stopping.
This intermediate beta excludes the new Linux hardware video decoding work. Existing video editing and playback remain available. Cloud services require your own configuration; recording requires microphone permission. Existing Siri and Shortcuts features are retained.
